summary: Full frontend E2E of Riparazioni + Telefonia + RBAC on preview. All acceptance criteria for the new servizi module pass. Backend already validated (149.14 verified live, 53/53 pytest per E1). Only nit: no-ricambio prezzo returns €44.94 (arithmetically correct: (30+30*0.22775)*1.22=44.9357 -> half-up 44.94) while the task text mentions 44.93 - not a bug. All test data cleaned up (2 servizi, 1 cliente, 2 test users incl. leftover TEST_Utente da iteration precedente).
